=== dry-run
exit 0
--- stdout
rename-project: alpha → beta
  projects/<name>.yaml    name alpha → beta
                          path <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha → <TMP>/home/workspace/beta
                          origin (native) → (native)
                          memory ~/git-origin/alpha-memory.git → ~/git-origin/beta-memory.git
  mirror-list.txt         (native) → (native)
  hub 主機                    mv ~/git-origin/alpha-memory.git → beta-memory.git
                          mv ~/.memory-copies/alpha → ~/.memory-copies/beta(origin 指向新 bare repo)
                          mv .state/alpha.sha → beta.sha
                          mirrors/(native).git → (native).git(如果名稱有變)
  本機                    remote mini → <TMP>/home/git-origin/beta-memory.git
                          mv <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha → <TMP>/home/workspace/beta + git worktree repair
(dry-run,加 --apply 才會執行)
--- stderr
